chunks: From Zurarah, he said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:
In the decree of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is all good for the believer.
ai.seo_question: What does the divine decree contain for a believer according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (a.s.) states that the divine decree (qada') of Allah encompasses all good for the believer. This highlights the concept that whatever Allah ordains, whether perceived as pleasant or difficult, contains underlying benefits and goodness for those who have faith.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 1. It has been narrated that Zurarah said “I heard Abu Jafar (a.s) say “
In the decree of Allah ﷻ , there is nothing but good for a believer”
